sheet.method: sheet stride simulated at 60 Hz for 4 s after a 2 s warm-up; animateLife(n, "walk") with the figure moved along +z at `speed` m/s (the sheet uses 1 m/s); the pavement is .13 under the origin in the world; flat = the sole's heel edge and toe tip both within 1 cm of the pavement; flatAnkleDriftCm = the ankle pivot's max horizontal travel while flat (the slide; flatAnkleNetCm its z travel, positive = forward with the body, i.e. skating); the heel-off roll that follows (heel up, toe tip within 1 cm) is reported apart: rollAnkleTravelCm (the foot turning over its toe, expected) and rollToeTipDriftCm (the toe tip it turns on, while it is on the pavement (within 3 mm): the slip there); lowestSoleCm the lowest heel or toe edge in the stance (negative = into the pavement). People XXI: the window was the lowest vertex within 1 cm of its lowest, which took in the heel-off roll
